01Case study

Smart Fruit Spoilageand Freshness Detection

An IoT system that reads environmental sensors around stored fruit and uses a machine learning model to predict freshness and shelf life in real time.

Category
IoT and Machine Learning
Year
2026
My role
Design, hardware and model
Status
Live

The problem

Fruit loses value quickly once it starts to spoil, and by the time spoilage is visible the loss has already happened. Traders and stores need an early signal, not a late one.

What I built

I developed an integrated IoT system that uses environmental sensors to monitor the conditions that indicate food and agricultural produce is degrading.

On top of the sensor data I built and deployed a machine learning model that analyses readings in real time and predicts food freshness and shelf life. The readings and predictions are shown on a live web dashboard.

What it does

  • Temperature, humidity and gas sensors feeding live data
  • A camera view of the fruit in storage
  • A deployed model that predicts freshness and shelf life
  • An inventory with a status and alert for each fruit
  • A dashboard anyone can open in a browser

Tools and technologies

  • ESP32
  • DHT22 sensor
  • MQ-135 gas sensor
  • ESP32-CAM
  • Machine learning
  • Python
  • Live web dashboard

See it running

Open the live dashboard

This project was pitched as AgroCool+ at the Nigeria Energy Forum student energy pitch challenge in June 2026. The dashboard is hosted on a free plan, so the first visit can take up to a minute to load.
